identity_rule: The Python runtime wheel and .skatmodel are separate versioned artifacts. Product bundles must bind both source commits and content hashes; wheel version 0.0.1 alone is not sufficient identity.
limits: This gate does not promote B0 or any challenger.
The installed runtime is Linux staging evidence, not Windows 11 deployment validation.
The final end-user package must bundle or install the target-platform Python runtime automatically; users must not be required to install uv or assemble dependencies manually.
Final accepted release identity, JSkat/Java runtime packaging, Windows legality/crash/replacement checks, p50/p95/p99 latency, and memory acceptance remain pending.
next_gate: When an accepted deployment-valid release is available, construct one source-bound product bundle containing the accepted .skatmodel, matching SkatAI runtime wheel, adapter JAR, patched JSkat distribution and target-platform runtimes; then validate on Windows 11.
